## Verifier — `pass` All four acceptance checks ran against the **running production build** (`npm ci` → `npm run build` → `npm run start -- --port 3000`, environment sourced from `.factory/sandbox/.runtime.env`), driven with curl and Chromium. Evidence is in the run artifact `verifier-evidence`. | \# | Check | Result | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | Line below the table reads exactly `Total sent: $1,497.50` | **pass** | `check1-invoices-page-full.png`, `check1-total-line-element.png` | | 2 | Served HTML contains the literal string unbroken | **pass** | `check2-grep-result.txt`, `check2-served-invoices.html` | | 3 | Total counts the same invoices the button does | **pass** | `check3-downloaded-export.csv`, screenshot above | | 4 | `/invoices/export` unchanged | **pass** | `check4-export-headers.txt`, `check4-export-body.csv` | ### What I did and what I saw **Check 1 — browser.** Opened ` (localhost/redacted) in Chromium. The accessibility snapshot shows `\- paragraph: "Total sent: $1,497.50"` as the last child of `(main)` , immediately after the table. Live DOM assertions in the page: the table's `nextElementSibling.tagName` is `P` , and that paragraph's `textContent` is **exactly** `Total sent: $1,497.50` (strict equality, not a substring match). There is exactly one `<p>` inside `(main)\`. Dollar sign, thousands comma and two decimals all present. **Check 2 — served HTML.** ` curl -s (localhost/redacted) then `grep -F\`: ``` occurrences of "Total sent: $1,497.50": 1 occurrences of "Total sent: ": 0

Total sent: $1,497.50

``` The single-template-literal form held; no comment marker split the children. **Check 3 — the total counts the same invoices the button does.** On the same page: the button reads `Export 3 invoices as CSV`, `` has **5** rows including INV-1004 (draft, 931.00) and INV-1005 (void, 450.00), and the total reads `$1,497.50`. The wrong-answer sentinel `$2,878.50` appears **nowhere** in the served HTML (`grep -c` returned 0). I went one step further than the check asks: I clicked the export button in the browser, captured the real download `invoices-2026-11-21.csv`, and summed its amount column — **149750 cents = $1,497.50**. The number shown on the page and the money actually in the exported file agree to the cent. Table cells still print bare amounts (`245.00`, `1180.00`), so `formatAmount` was not widened. **Check 4 — export untouched.** \`curl -s -D- (localhost/redacted) ``` HTTP/1.1 200 OK content-type: text/csv; charset=utf-8 content-disposition: attachment; filename="invoices.csv" cache-control: no-store ``` Body is 4 lines: the header `id,customer,amount,issued_on,status` plus exactly three data rows (INV-1001, INV-1002, INV-1003). A regex for `INV-1004` / `INV-1005` matched 0 times. ### Ways I tried to make it look right but be wrong - **Empty and negative cases.** Compiled `lib/invoices.ts` to a scratch directory and called the new functions directly (`probe-pure-functions.txt`): `totalCents([])` returns `0`, not `NaN`; `formatCurrency(0)` returns `$0.00`; `formatCurrency(-24500)` returns `-$245.00`. `totalCents` does not mutate the list it is handed, and the module-level `Intl.NumberFormat` returns a stable string across repeated calls. - **A second click.** Clicked export again; the total line was still present and unchanged afterwards. - **A reload.** After reloading, the paragraph text is still exactly `Total sent: $1,497.50`, and no React hydration-mismatch warning appeared — the server-rendered single text node and the client agree. - **A different route into the same screen.** Navigated from `/` and clicked `Go to invoices`, which is a client-side RSC navigation rather than the prerendered-HTML path. The total renders identically (`check1-after-client-nav-from-home.png`). - **Repeat requests.** Three cache-busted `curl` requests all returned the string, so this is not an artifact of one cached response. - **Console.** One entry for the entire session: a `404` for `/favicon.ico`. It is pre-existing and unrelated — `git ls-tree -r HEAD~1` shows no favicon asset in the repo before this change either, and the diff touches only `lib/invoices.ts` and `app/invoices/page.tsx`. Details in `console-notes.txt`. Nothing was blocked by the sandbox, so no `sandbox-report.json` was written. The server was stopped and the browser closed; no leftover processes. > Generated by [Verifier](https://github.com/bsf-fixtures/ts-webapp/actions/runs/44847233576) for #19 · claude · opus50 · \~103 AIC · ⌖ \~25 AIC · ⊞ 2.6K · [◷](https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Absf-fixtures%2Fts-webapp+%22gh-aw-workflow-call-id%3A+bsf-fixtures%2Fts-webapp%2Ffactory-role-verifier%22&type=issues)
